deadline.source_discrepancy: The Amendment 2 BAA schedule line prints July 22, 2025; the 2026 SBIR topic record, DLA Release 3 schedule, and package sources agree on July 22, 2026.

start_here.title: Submit the JCP application and retain official evidence
start_here.instruction: Use the official JCP portal. Registration or prerequisites in progress are not enough; retain the official application-submission receipt PDF or a current certified DD Form 2345 in the ignored private evidence area.
start_here.why_first: Volume 5 cannot be locked without the required official JCP/DD Form 2345 evidence for the current ITAR-marked scope.

operator_focus.instruction: Work the pre-submission evidence stage first. Do not spend action-time approval or certify final submission until the upload set and fresh portal preview are complete.

lifecycle_stages.title: Do now
lifecycle_stages.description: Evidence, content, registration, and portal facts required before the bounded final-submission gate can open.

lifecycle_stages.title: Bound the pre-award position
lifecycle_stages.description: The proposal must state a current bounded position. Implementation proof may occur during pre-award or contract negotiation only if the live portal or contracting office permits it; these gates remain fail-closed now.

lifecycle_stages.title: Do last
lifecycle_stages.description: Fresh preview, corporate review, and final authorization occur only after the upload set is stable and immediately before the human submit action.

cmmc.official_note: Amendment 2 says CMMC Phase II implementation was suspended on July 13, 2026 while Phase I self-assessment requirements remain in place; the current live requirement must be reviewed before submission.
cmmc.safe_rule: Do not mark the Phase I position supported from projected topic text alone; use current authoritative evidence or a qualified reviewed not-applicable determination.

technology_control_plan.official_note: The DLA component instructions say an ITAR/EAR topic firm may be required to submit a Technology Control Plan during contracting negotiation. This does not establish a current proposal-upload requirement, plan approval, or contracting-office acceptance.
technology_control_plan.safe_rule: Document only the present lifecycle position: a TCP may be requested during contracting negotiation. Do not claim it was submitted, approved, or accepted unless separate evidence proves that event.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Submit the JCP application and retain official evidence
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Use the official JCP portal. Registration or prerequisites in progress are not enough; retain the official application-submission receipt PDF or a current certified DD Form 2345 in the ignored private evidence area.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Hash-matched official JCP receipt PDF or certified DD Form 2345
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: The founder completes any portal certification or final JCP submit action.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Confirm Firm PIN availability inside DSIP
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Confirm that the organization-linked DSIP account can access the Firm PIN. Do not place the PIN itself in chat, Git, logs, or the private gate record.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Boolean availability state only; never the PIN value
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: The founder handles authentication and any secret value.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Support and approve the Volume 3 cost basis
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Review the proposed labor rate, 640 PI hours, fringe, indirect base, cloud/data, travel, software/storage, no-subcontractor position, and 100,000 dollar total against actual records before approving the cost volume.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Current founder records and corporate-official cost review
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: The founder confirms the factual cost basis; the builder checks arithmetic only.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Review conflicts, cost separation, data rights, CMMC, and export-control planning
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Answer conflicts and joint-venture status from current facts; reconcile the no-duplicate-cost position and technical-data-rights schedule against source records; review the live CMMC requirement; preserve the no-overclaim position; and document the bounded Technology Control Plan position. The DLA component instructions say an ITAR/EAR topic firm may be required to submit a TCP during contracting negotiation; that does not establish a current proposal-upload requirement or agency acceptance.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Current source review, hash-bound documentary register, and bounded founder/corporate-official position
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: No compliance, assessment, certification, or contracting-office acceptance is inferred.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Lock the Volume 5 supporting-document set
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Upload only current, applicable documents. For the ITAR-marked scope, include the verified JCP/DD Form 2345 evidence required by the BAA; do not upload the obsolete foreign-affiliations PDF.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Reviewed attachment list with current file hashes
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: Any legally consequential upload or representation remains founder reviewed.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Review and seal a fresh complete DSIP preview
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: After every field and upload is final, inspect all seven volumes, filenames, hashes, cost totals, and the live deadline. Save the current preview receipt privately and bind it with the collector.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Fresh portal-preview receipt bound to the exact upload set
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: The founder reviews the rendered Government portal preview.

ordered_founder_steps.title: Perform corporate review and action-time authorization
ordered_founder_steps.instruction: Only after the fresh preview is stable, review every volume as corporate official, capture the short-lived approval binding, and authorize the exact final submission.
ordered_founder_steps.evidence_required: Fresh approval timestamp and binding to the current preview/upload set
ordered_founder_steps.human_boundary: The final certification and submit click are founder-only actions.

outreach_control.next_action: The bounded proactive follow-up allowance is exhausted. Monitor the existing thread and respond only to a specific inbound request.

human_only_actions: Enter passwords, Firm PIN values, and one-time authentication codes.
Confirm entity, cost, conflicts, rights, CMMC, and export-control facts.
Complete any JCP or DSIP certification or legal attestation.
Review the complete rendered Government portal preview.
Authorize and click the final DSIP submit control.
claim_boundary: This card is a current operator checklist derived from local control artifacts. It does not prove JCP approval, DD Form 2345 certification, CMMC status, ITAR compliance, proposal submission, DLA receipt, eligibility, selection, award, endorsement, deployment, technical validation, funding, or value.
